thread:
Maya Li: Quick heads-up — starting a focused sweep of high-privileged service accounts and KMS-related roles across infra projects today. Target set: svc/*, any user/service account with roles/cloudkms.admin or iam.serviceAccountAdmin. Goal is least-priv reduction before EOM. Who can own each project set?
Ben Ortiz: +1. can you drop the query you used? I'll run on infra-staging.
Maya Li: sure — basic query I run: ```gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role | test("roles/(owner|editor|cloudkms.admin|iam.serviceAccountAdmin)"))'``` run on infra-prod and infra-staging with a dry-run flag. Export bindings to CSV for owners.
Priya Shah: fyi last sweep flagged automation svc accounts that need kms-encrypt during deploys. we'll need a whitelist csv so we don't break pipelines.
Jonah Lee: i can own infra-prod set. creating RDW ticket RDW-789 and will add checklist + pager for rollout windows.
Amanda Chen: remediation pattern we prefer: 1) rotate keys if creds leaked, 2) create narrowly-scoped SA for workload, 3) update CI to use short-lived impersonation. track all changes in #security-audit.
access-review-bot: Reminder: periodic-access-review scheduled in 7 days. See https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-789
Ben Ortiz: ran the query on infra-staging — found 14 principals with cloudkms.admin bindings. pushing CSV -> gs://redwood-sec/priv-samples/infra-staging-14.csv
Maya Li: drop the link here + assign owners in the CSV. we'll do least-priv reviews by next Wed. @Jonah can you confirm infra-prod timeline?
Jonah Lee: confirmed. i'll triage the 14 and escalate anything that blocks deploys. will ping owners directly.
Priya Shah: doing vuln triage in parallel — one SA had a binding to service-networking.googleapis.com which looks excessive. opening vuln ticket RDW-790 with evidence.
Amanda Chen: suggest policy: no direct user bindings to SA keys; require ephemeral creds or impersonation for interactive access. drafting a policy PR.
Maya Li: action items recap: Jonah - infra-prod triage (due 1808179200), Ben - infra-staging remediation (due 1808164800), Priya - create vuln ticket (RDW-790). we'll review in next weekly sec-sync and record in the compliance workspace.
Ben Ortiz: posted results in the shared sheet and added :thumbsup:. will attach remediation diffs here once changes applied.
Jonah Lee: quick q — how do we classify roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter? high or medium?
Maya Li: treat cloudkms.admin and roles that grant key admin (cryptoKeyAdmin) as high-priv. encrypter/decrypter = medium; include it in sampling only if the principal also has broad IAM roles or SA impersonation.
Priya Shah: also include principals that appear in audit logs as impersonators (protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail + impersonation entries). i'll run a filter on audit logs for `methodName:"google.iam.credentials"` and attach hits.
Amanda Chen: when you export findings, please put chain-of-evidence in the compliance workspace (timestamped exports + owner notes) so auditors can trace decisions.
access-review-bot: Audit export started for infra-prod -> gs://redwood-audit-exports/1807502222-prod-export.json
Jonah Lee: mid-sweep note: found 2 human users with cloudkms.admin directly bound. emailed owners, awaiting replies.
Maya Li: perfect. if we need rollback plan, follow runbook: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/access-prune-runbook.md — includes steps for key rotation and SA recreation.
Ben Ortiz: will attach remediation PRs and link to RDW-789/790 here.
Maya Li: thanks everyone — let's keep updates concise in-thread. we'll close the sweep once owners sign off and commits are merged. :white_check_mark:
